recommendation.regulation_context:
During a Safety Car period, it is compulsory that drivers do not change to a different specification of tyres or use any other specification of tyres while the Safety Car is on the track. A penalty under Article 54.3d) will be imposed if a driver changes tyres to a different specification during this time (Article 54.3). The Safety Car will enter the pits after one lap unless specific conditions apply, such as wet conditions requiring wet-weather tyres (Article 30.5). 

Thus, tyre changes are regulated to prevent switching to different tyre specifications while the Safety Car is deployed, and the Safety Car's timing for entering the pits is also specified (Articles 54.3 and 30.5).

A penalty under Article 54.3d) will be imposed if a driver changes tyres to a different specification during this time (Article 54.3). The Safety Car will enter the pits after one lap unless certain conditions apply, such as wet conditions requiring the use of wet-weather tyres (Article 58.10). 

Thus, tyre changes are regulated to prevent switching to different tyre specifications while the Safety Car is deployed, and the Safety Car's timing for entering the pits is also specified (Articles 54.3 and 58.10).
